[b]Increasing THEP security[/b]

The government of Rosenmarkke on October 2, following the radical energy dominance decision, would be pressured by prior THEP commitments, namely the commitment to build bases in fellow THEP members.

While the SCSID had avoided taking any sort of explicit expansionist approach towards THEP, having pressured the 29th triumvirate to withdraw partial financial support of the alliance's military commitments. 

However, Strømm believed that the next best way to combat EDU dominance was to assert THEP dominance. As a result, she moved to begin negotiations to build joint defense bases in the member states of THEP, offering to utilise local allies' labor to build the bases, which were to be located in strategic locations chosen and agreed upon by the SCSID and the governments of those nations. 

As a result, Strømm lobbied the NBC to allocate 12 Billion from the black budget to the construction and deals of the bases. 

(tldr: Rosenmarkke has offered to build joint military bases in y'alls states)

[quote=british_calradia;61188507]Mr T replies with; 

"On second thoughts, I think we'll rescind the volunteers to your nation. It is logistically impossible to gather up 50k potential expats and deliver them to this nation under the already heavy opposition. In addition, we do not want an entire alliance against us like what you have ended up having. So it is best that we do not engage in hostile action with any nation besides the Gaesunians."

"But going back to the this offer, I also suggest that before partaking in such a deadly endeavour we must act in a honourable way and to first engage in negotiations to settle for peace. If that is not done to a satisfactory manner, then we can engage in destroying their waters and water supply. Yes that idea of very strong alcohol that looks like tea is very smart, I'd also suggest adding in tiny amounts of lead and mercury to make it even more deadlier. I also propose the idea of sending in sleeper agents into Gaesun for intelligence gathering.... [i]and to do a little trolling[/i]"

It is then negotiated that the AAO agent will be sent to Empire Island to help train and guide the conscripted Imperial Brigades. It is also requested that another AAO agent be sent to help the local militia and police in the Northwest Frontier to help fight against Raffordic guerrillas. Along with that, shared designs of cheap but effective drones to be given to the Dutch state along with partial Balionic private sector funding and ownership of Dutch factories that will be vital for infrastructure and the military industry.[/quote]

[Spoiler]Klaas frowns a bit at the refusal before blinking and says, "somewhat of a disappointment for your refusal but i can see your reasons in it." Klaas pulls out a telegram from the drawer and places it on the table, "our F-14AN's is starting to get a bit outdated. We stil have more advanced uiterwaard trapdoor jets but they can't go up against actual stealth aircraft. How about a small project between both our research departments to see into the possibility of having our own stealth planes? Maybe we can develop more advanced radars that can detect stealth better."
Once the question of peace gets asked Klaas sighs and responds, "as much as i love or hate the idea of peace i fear that the population won't accept a foreign country's army in the country acting as occupier if we surrender unconditionally. There are chances and small signs it will erupt into a full blown guerilla war. I won't even rule out if war crimes get committed on both sides. But i will take your advice."[/spoiler]

[b]Pan-Shamatine Unity: An Essential Process[/b]
[i]Polenne Strømm Speaking at the Annual Conference for Shamatine Immigrants[/b]

My dear friends,

I come before you today to address the recent rising ideology that overshadows every nation on the Shamatine continents, one which seeks unification and freedom across all statesI speak to you about Pan-shamatism.

For centuries, Shamat and its nations have been divided, warring against each other and making haste into each other's land like barbarians; however, as  the world becomes more chaotic, the brave nations of Shamat have sought to make themselves united.

It is thus that I announce my public support for a unified and stronger Shamat! And I promise you, Rosenmarkke shall take all necessary steps to ensure that this dream, your dream, becomes true, my dear friends. No longer shall you wish upon a star, merely wish upon a rose, and your dreams come true!

Statement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of [nation]Pirabad[/nation]

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Pirabad reaffirms the governments commitment to regional cooperation and economic recovery. Under the leadership of Minister Mahmoud Nezami, Pirabad is actively seeking to establish mutually beneficial trade agreements with neighboring and regional partners.

Despite current challenges, Pirabad remains open for lawful commerce, investment, and infrastructure cooperation. We believe regional trade is essential to restoring economic stability, strengthening supply chains, and improving the livelihoods of our people.

The Ministry invites interested governments to engage in direct dialogue to explore pragmatic frameworks for trade, transit, and economic partnership, grounded in mutual respect and regional stability.

Chancellors Address Before the Republikenrat

[i]Representatives of the Republikenrat, members of the National Security Council, the people of the Republik and those now fighting in Kolionia, 

The operation to secure Kolionia is successful.

The defense forces have successfully captured the capital city of Kolioa and the enemy in its ability to mount a resistance has been broken.
